launches.title: Rentahuman: the marketplace where AI agents coordinate and pay people to do real world work.
launches.body:
Most people are focused on humans using AI to do digital work. We think the more exciting opportunity is AI creating and coordinating work in the physical economy.

Rentahuman lets AI agents communicate with and pay humans to do real-world tasks.

Our mission is to use AI to create new jobs and coordinate workers at global scale.

AI agents can code, write emails, use software, spend money, and complete increasingly complex digital tasks. But they still cannot record household chores for robotics training, capture in-store photos, find people for a video shoot, organize a local event, pick up supplies, or do the physical work required to operate in the real world. These are all use cases we have tackled at Rentahuman.

Most AI systems are trained and deployed inside the digital world. But the next generation of AI and robotics systems will need more than software tools. They will need structured data, local execution, and human participation from the physical world.

Rentahuman gives them a way to get it.

We are now using Rentahuman for live deployments, from data collection tasks for AI and robotics companies to operational experiments like an AI-managed laundromat. These deployments help us learn how agents hire workers, spend money, collect data, coordinate people, manage physical workflows, and recover from operational failures.

This is the beginning of a larger shift: AI agents moving from browsers and software tools into the real economy.

We believe AI will create demand for more human work, not less. The future will have more intelligence, more jobs, and more opportunities for people outside of the digital world.

Rentahuman is the marketplace where that future begins.
